card.name: "or" ending contraindication drug lists
card.fires_on: The word "or" after a comma-separated list of drug names in a hypersensitivity contraindication, just before "any of the excipients/components". Weaker hits occur on endings of a few drug names such as mesylate, edisylate and levetiracetam.
